senses.gloss: m.(also pl. form פְּתַכְרי) (denom. of פתכא, v. פַּתְכּוּמְרִין) [painted thing,] a contemptuous expression for idol.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 5:26">Targ. Am. V, 26</cite> <he>פְּתַכְרֵיכוֹן</he> ed. Lag. (ed. <he>פת כומריכון</he>; h. text <he>מלככם</he>).
